source.title: Warhammer 40,000: The App 2.6.0, data build 946, released 2026-09-02

data.summary:
When this model's unit finishes shooting in your [Shooting phase](vsdata:core-rule/shooting-phase), pick 1 enemy unit hit by at least 1 attack this model made with its Dread of the Deep Void. That unit is riven for the rest of the turn.

Each time a friendly **AELDARI** model attacks a riven unit, the attack's Strength is increased by 1.
